newsitem.title: UK: EMI up amid renewed merger hopes.
newsitem.headline: EMI up amid renewed merger hopes.

text.p: Shares in EMI Group Plc rose in early trading on Monday after a weekend report revived speculation of a merger with Seagram's MCA Music unit, though EMI denied it was in talks with MCA.
The stock was up 11-1/2p at 13.42-1/2 stg by 0831 GMT.
Traders said EMI would likely to continue to be the focus of talk of bids and mergers in the global music industry.

"Obviously it is a very valuable company and there are so many big international players with big pockets," said one. "But that doesn't mean there has to be a bid from MCA or that it will happen next week."
The Independent on Sunday newspaper said talks were going on between the two, but a spokesman for EMI yesterday said the report of merger talks with MCA was "complete rubbish."
